ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the food web, what is the relationship between the algae and the snail?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. At the bottom of the diagram there is an “Algae” label, on the right side there is a “Snail” label, and there is an arrow from Algae to Snail. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate that energy or food flows from the organism that is eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, snails eat algae; algae are producers, and snails are consumers. The relationship between the two is producer-consumer.
